fullDescription: A high-end SaaS management dashboard featuring a dynamic 'View-to-Edit' transition. It utilizes a sophisticated blue and navy palette, premium typography (General Sans and Satoshi), and a responsive split-panel layout. The design moves seamlessly from a full-width data table in an idle state to a 1/3 - 2/3 split screen for detailed editing. Ideal for fintech, telecommunications, CRM, and enterprise administrative portals where high-volume data interaction and granular editing are required.
prompt:
## Resumo
Professional enterprise dashboard with a dual-state layout: a comprehensive full-width table for data overview and an animated split-panel interface for detailed object editing. Features high-contrast status badges, smooth slide-and-fade transitions, and a clean, modernist aesthetic.

## Estilo Visual
### Visual Style Guide

**Color Palette:**
- Primary Action: #0066ff (Nextiva Blue)
- Deep Text/Primary Dark: #02122c (Navy)
- Success: #10b981 (Emerald)
- Warning: #FFB800 (Amber)
- Danger: #ef4444 (Red)
- Surface/Background: #f8fafc
- Borders: #e2e8f0
- Selection/Highlight: #f0f9ff

**Typography:**
- **Headings:** 'General Sans', semi-bold (600) to bold (700). Letter spacing: -0.02em.
- **Body/UI:** 'Satoshi', medium (500) to regular (400). 
- **Labels/Badges:** 'Satoshi' bold (700), uppercase, tracking: 0.1em, size: 10px.

**Shadows & Borders:**
- Default border: 1px solid #e2e8f0.
- Cards/Sections: 12px to 24px border-radius.
- Hover shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05).

**Animations:**
- Panel Slide: 350ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).
- Opacity Fades: 300ms ease-in-out.
- Hover Transitions: All properties 200ms ease.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Design a 64px (h-16) white header with a 1px bottom border (#e2e8f0). Include a left-aligned logo (navy) and a breadcrumb navigation using chevron icons (#94a3b8). Right-align user profile with a circular initials-avatar (blue background) and a vertical divider.

### Dynamic Action Bar
Create a sub-header section with 32px padding (p-8). Left side: H1 title and 14px secondary description. Right side: A button group that disappears when an item is selected. Buttons should have a 12px radius, uppercase labels, and include primary (blue gradient) and secondary (outline blue) variants.

### Main Content: Idle Table State
The idle state features a full-width table. Table headers should be 10px uppercase slate-400 text with tracking-widest. Rows have a 16px vertical padding. Include a checkbox column, username (bold navy), status badges with light background tints (e.g., emerald-100 bg for green text), and an action icon (edit). Add a pagination footer with 'Previous/Next' buttons and page indicators.

### Main Content: Selected Split State
When an item is clicked, animate a left panel (33.3% width) sliding in. This panel contains a searchable vertical list of items. Highlight the selected item with a light blue background (#f0f9ff) and a 4px solid blue left border. The right panel (66.7% width) replaces the table with a detailed edit form.

### Detail Edit Form
Organize the 66.7% width right panel into a scrollable form with 40px padding. Include a header with a 'Back' button and 'Save/Cancel' actions. Section the form into 'Identity', 'Preferences', and 'Organization' using thin horizontal rules. Include a 'Danger Zone' at the bottom with a red-tinted background card and a 'Delete' button.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status Badge — High-contrast small badges for state indication.
Create a badge with 4px vertical / 8px horizontal padding. Font size 10px, weight 700, uppercase. Border-radius 6px. Color combinations: Active (Emerald-700 on Emerald-100), Suspended (Amber-700 on Amber-100), Inactive (Slate-500 on Slate-100).

### Interactive List Item — The left-panel user list item with specific active state behavior.
Design a list item with a checkbox, 2-line text (bold title, regular subtext), and a right-aligned mono-font data point. On selection, apply #f0f9ff background and a 4px #0066ff left-border. Ensure the transition between normal and selected states is 200ms ease.

### Bento Avatar — A unique large avatar used in the edit profile section.
A 80px (w-20, h-20) container with 28px border-radius (squircle). Soft blue background (#dbeafe), 4px white border, and a 36px blue icon (#0066ff) centered within. Subtle drop shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05).

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Use 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' for all panel width transitions to ensure a high-end feel. MUST NOT: Allow the left panel to overlap the right; it must push the right panel to 66.7% width. MUST: Stagger the opacity of the form fields to fade in 50ms after the panel starts sliding for a more dynamic UI feel.

style.description: The style is 'Corporate Modernist' with a focus on legibility and motion. It pairs 'General Sans' for bold headings with 'Satoshi' for UI elements. Colors are rooted in deep navy (#02122c) and high-action blue (#0066ff), with soft slate backgrounds (#f8fafc) and emerald/amber/red for status feedback. Micro-interactions include vertical translation on button hover and smooth cubic-bezier transitions for panel sliding.
